name: engagement-os
description: A repeatable operating model for document-heavy consulting engagements, bid to delivery. Composable: scaffold a repo as bid-only, delivery-only, both, or a bare client-research base. Pursuit side: analyse an RFP, research the gaps, write a compliant tender response. Delivery side: ingest client materials to citable markdown, maintain a canonical fact base, write and validate findings, build deliverables through a panel review gate, keep agent memory lean. Source material is kept separate per phase so bid and delivery evidence never pool. The agent drafts every artefact from what you told it and asks only the residual — you never open a file to fill a template. 11 skills (eng-*) plus 6 playbook slash-commands, templates, and deterministic scripts including a lint that decides the mechanical invariants (confidentiality leaks, unverified claims in shipped artefacts, unmet mandatory requirements).
